claim: The DNA Polymerase α (Pol α)/primase complex initiates DNA synthesis in eukaryotic replication.
source_text: The DNA Polymerase α (Pol α)/primase complex initiates DNA synthesis in eukaryotic replication.
evidence_reasoning: This is established scientific knowledge about eukaryotic replication, supported by the broader literature context of the manuscript.

claim: In the Pol α/primase complex, Pol α and primase cooperate in the production of RNA-DNA oligonucleotides that prime synthesis of new DNA.

claim: Crystal structures of the catalytic core of yeast Pol α were determined in unliganded form, bound to an RNA primer/DNA template, and extending an RNA primer with deoxynucleotides.

evidence_reasoning: This is a direct report of experimental structural data obtained by the authors through X-ray crystallography.

claim: Pol α specifically recognizes the A-form RNA/DNA helix.

claim: Cellular organisms initiate DNA synthesis during genome duplication by the universal mechanism of RNA priming.
